historical_commentary.text: FastCGI and standalone CGI-style integration have been largely superseded in the current 4D ecosystem by 4D's own mature built-in web server (used both for the classic web publishing features and, more recently, for Qodly/REST-based application delivery), so this note's specific approach is now of mostly historical interest, though the general performance principle (avoiding per-request process spawning) remains a valid systems-design lesson.
related_updates: 4D's own built-in web server has long superseded the need for external CGI/FastCGI-based web integration in typical 4D deployments
